title: THE SHOP SHOWS ITS ITEMS BIG
why: Seen on the shop screenshot of 2026-10-07: the new item pictures filled only 44% of a shop, craft or hire tile, small in a lot of empty tile. They fill 60% now, which still leaves room for the name under them at every tile size.
now: Items in the shop, craft and hire lists are shown about a third bigger.

edits.replacement: .vcell .ic{ width:60% !important; height:60% !important; object-fit:contain; }   /* v16.xx, seen on the shop screenshot (2026-10-07): the new pictures were 44% of a shop, craft or hire tile, small in a lot of empty tile; 60% still leaves room for the name */
